title: 업로드 주문등록 및 출고리스트 엑셀 생성 계약

actions.name: SHOW_READ_ONLY_EXCEL_SHEET_PREVIEW
actions.note: selected worksheet cells are returned as a capped read-only preview; matched source rows are highlighted; no ERP ledger writes

actions.name: SHOW_INLINE_EXCEL_ROW_MATCH_CELLS
actions.note: each parsed source row inserts compact single-line ERP product, final quantity, unit, and status immediately after the purchase/order quantity column; a sigma badge inside the original purchase quantity cell shows grouped row count and aggregate final quantity; remaining source columns continue to the right; edits remain client draft state until explicit registration

actions.name: SAVE_CUSTOMER_SCOPED_PRODUCT_MAPPING
actions.mappingPolicy: manual product choices are keyed by exact CustKey plus normalized source product token; customer mapping overrides the legacy global mapping only for that customer; another customer cannot read or overwrite it; missing customer mapping falls back to the legacy global mapping

actions.name: USE_PAGE_VERTICAL_SCROLL_FOR_IMPORT_REVIEW
actions.note: Excel preview, aggregate table, and progress log expand vertically in document flow; horizontal table overflow remains available; no nested vertical scrollbar hides rows

actions.name: SHOW_MATCHED_PRODUCT_QUANTITY_AGGREGATES
actions.note: active matched rows are grouped by ProdKey+unit and ordered by their first Excel source row; the registration request and post-write result preserve that product order; mixed units for one ProdKey block explicit registration

actions.name: MANUAL_PRODUCT_REMATCH_AND_REUPLOAD
actions.mappingPolicy: saved manual ProdKey wins over automatic rose candidate ranking; the UI waits for mapping persistence; automatic confidence alone never overwrites persistent mappings; ERP ledgers remain unchanged until explicit registration

actions.name: APPLY_CUSTOMER_WEEK_FINAL_ORDER_SNAPSHOT
actions.note: uploaded rows are aggregated by ProdKey inside the file and become exact final quantities; active existing products omitted from the file become zero/deleted in the same transaction; an omitted product with ShipmentDetail blocks and rolls back the entire snapshot; replaying the same file is idempotent

actions.name: SHOW_REGISTER_RESULT_AFTER_POST
actions.note: result display performs a read-after-write only; explicit operator click shows stage logs and UI re-GETs ViewOrder with OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustName

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe FormOrderAdd 주문 업무키 및 저장 흐름
